Sasha (Marketing): Quick micro-thread. We need a short test of copy that ties latency->dollars to a developer action. Keep it punchy for homepage hero.

Ellen (Data): Suggest: show median latency (ms) on x, cost cents/1k on y. Add two modifiers as badges: 'cache on' and 'quantized'. I'll supply a tiny CSV for mocks.

Marco (Design): Ok. Two visual treatments: 1) compact scatter with badges, 2) horizontal mini-CDF showing 95/99 and a red SLA band. Clean, single accent color.

Priya (Growth): Headline variants: A) "Predictable latency. Predictable cost." B) "Lower unit cost, faster responses." We'll A/B test. Keep subhead short: "Controls: batching, cache, quant."

Claude (Product): Add product line: "Dedicated capacity + smart routing reduces tail risk and preserves availability." One sentence.

Ellen (Data): CSV snippet for Marco: ```
workload,variant,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_cents_per_1k
chat,redwood-quant,42,175,1.2
chat,redwood-quant+cache,27,110,0.8
embed,embed-lite,18,40,0.6
```

Marco (Design): I'll mock both treatments and include a tiny footnote: measurement on A100-like GPU, median over N=200 requests. Uploading to Drive.

UploadBot: Assets uploaded to https://drive.redwood.dev/bench/1705209999 (scatter_mini.png, tails_mini.png, dataset.csv).

Sasha (Marketing): Perfect. Action items: Ellen -> full CSV + methods; Marco -> final PNGs; Priya -> A/B setup. I'll draft the micro-copy tonight and circulate for quick review tomorrow. This thread is canonical for the micro hero copy test. :rocket:
